body:
Welcome to the future of oral hygiene! SuperMouth is proud to unveil our most advanced innovation yet: the Ultim8™ SmartBrush™ System. This groundbreaking development in oral care technology offers a superior cleaning experience with smart design and cutting-edge features.

Why We Reinvented the Toothbrush

Current Challenges with Traditional Toothbrushes:

  1. Inadequate Cleaning in Hard-to-Reach Areas: Traditional toothbrush bristles, largely unchanged since the invention of the “modern” toothbrush in 1938, fail to adapt to the natural curves of our teeth, especially between the back teeth and around braces, where cavities frequently develop.
  2. Dental Sensitivity: A common issue exacerbated by high-speed electric toothbrushes that can lead to enamel abrasion and gum recession due to their hard bristles (even with many that claim “soft” bristles).
  3. Contamination Risks: Research shows that toothbrushes can harbor more microbes than a toilet or a public restroom floor, including E.coli, viruses, and fungi.

Our Solutions with the ULTIM8 SmartBrush System:

  1. Superior Cleaning with Contoured Bristles: After years of research and scanning thousands of teeth, we’ve developed our SuperBristles® Pro, which fit perfectly along the natural contours of your teeth, delivering up to an incredible 40 times better cleaning and plaque removal than manual brushes. For orthodontic patients, our SuperBristles Ortho provide unmatched cleaning efficiency, reaching up to an astonishing 60 times better around brackets and wires.
  2. Gentle Yet Effective Brushing: Our brush heads feature triple the usual number of ultra-soft bristles, offering a gentle yet thorough cleaning that protects both teeth and gums from damage.
  3. Hygienic SmartHub: The SmartHub enhances your brushing routine with a UV sanitizer and dryer to keep your brush clean, plus a wireless charger, rinse cup, and protective cap for ultimate hygiene and convenience.

Design and Aesthetics

The Ultim8 SmartBrush System doesn’t just perform exceptionally—it also looks stunning. Available in a variety of gorgeous colors, its sleek design fits beautifully into any bathroom décor.

Complement Your Routine with SuperMouth

Expand your oral care regimen with our comprehensive range of products designed for every family member. From our custom systems based on age or stage, to our advanced toothpastes and mouthwashes, to expanding flosses and custom tongue cleaners, SuperMouth offers solutions for every age and stage of dental health.

Discover more about the Ultim8 SmartBrush System and our full range of dental care innovations by visiting our website. Experience the next level of oral care with SuperMouth, where we merge scientific innovation with daily dental hygiene.
